workflows.description: Example workflow demonstrating conditional step execution with when: gates. Steps activate or skip based on input parameters at runtime.

workflows.name: consensus_review
workflows.description: Self-consistency / ensemble review pattern. Three independent reviewers answer the SAME prompt in parallel; a deterministic tier-0 aggregator majority-votes their verdicts; a final summary step runs only when the vote clears the agreement t

workflows.name: fullstack_generation
workflows.description: Generate a complete fullstack feature with parallel frontend/backend development

workflows.name: iterative_review
workflows.description: Example workflow demonstrating bounded review-rework loops with loop_until and loop_max. Code is generated, reviewed, and reworked iteratively until approved or the maximum round count is reached.

workflows.name: plan_tribunal
workflows.description: Multi-judge review of proposed implementation plans. A brief step distils the source documents into a candidate slate (P1..Pn) plus a shared domain brief; five persona judges (verification, concurrency, pragmatist, governance, adversary) ea
